resources.string: Calls on your computer
Use %1$s for calls
Tap to pair over Bluetooth. Call audio stays on this phone until you choose the computer.
Your computer is waiting to pair for calls
Use %1$s for calls
This pairs your phone with %1$s over Bluetooth, so you can see, answer and place your phone\'s calls on the computer.
Call audio stays on this phone. It moves to the computer only when you answer there or choose to use the computer for that call.
Android will show a pairing code. Pair only if %1$s shows the same code.
Android may also ask whether to share contacts and call history. Luma doesn\'t read them over Bluetooth yet, so you can leave that off.
Luma Connect will ask for permission to connect to nearby Bluetooth devices. It uses it only to pair with this computer.
